verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a hosted agent service with a public API surface. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The status mechanisms it does document are in-session MCP progress notifications, polling the same thread_id, and an in-band auth_required event, plus a pull-based Analytics API. These are adjacent features, not event subscriptions a programmatic consumer can receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
